subject: Startups
title: Move Fast and Break Laws
description: Learn Move Fast and Break Laws in one minute.

hook.text: Uber launched in cities without taxi licenses. Airbnb listed apartments that violated zoning laws. Both grew anyway.

buildup.text: Some startups use the 'ask for forgiveness, not permission' playbook.

discovery.text: If the product is popular enough, regulators face political pressure to accommodate it.

twist.text: This only works for well-funded companies.

climax.text: The strategy is high risk. Uber succeeded. Many others faced fines, bans, or criminal charges for the same approach.

punchline.text: Breaking rules can work—if you're big enough to survive the consequences.

quiz.question: Why did Uber's 'break rules first' strategy work?
options: Massive user adoption created political pressure to accommodate them
